Name: Samson
Summary: Samson was a Nazirite judge of supernatural strength who fought the Philistines but was undone by compromise and his love for Delilah. In final repentance, God used him once more.
KeyStory: Blinded and grinding in prison, Samson prayed for strength one last time and pulled down the temple of Dagon on the Philistine lords.
LifeLesson: Samson's hair grew back in prison — a quiet sign that grace was returning. Even after our worst compromises, a repentant prayer can still move the hand of God.
